scope: Re.route private Swiss beta. API access, data licences and software licences are separate. Unknown rights are not permission. This register is an engineering audit, not legal clearance.

sources.source: SwitzerlandMobility / FEDRO / cantons — cycling routes and closures via geo.admin.ch
sources.licence: Open Government Data, open use with source attribution (BY); GeoIV Article 21. Applies to the Veloland geometry and closure data. Texts/photos/logos have separate conditions.
sources.attribution: Bundesamt für Strassen, Kanton, Stiftung SchweizMobil; official route name/number and link retained.
sources.caching: App: route lookups 24 hours, closure lookups 15 minutes in bounded server memory. No browser bulk download. Source geometries update periodically; request time is not an edition or field-observation date.
sources.redistribution: Open-use geometry under attribution. Re.route alterations/connectors are explicitly identified. No marketing descriptions, photographs, logos, partner iframe or Komoot tours copied.
sources.limits: Explicit request only; three candidate sections; capped identify responses marked partial; 120 km search-area diagonal, 80 km selected official section, 4 MB response, 30,000 route vertices. Closure errors/caps prevent applying.
sources.status: Enabled for attributed geometry; service availability and physical conditions not guaranteed.

sources.source: OpenStreetMap data — Overpass parking/amenities; routing and place data
sources.licence: Open Database Licence 1.0 (ODbL); individual contents may carry separate rights.
sources.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, linked to copyright/licence. Routing views include a map-correction link.
sources.caching: App: public facility records generally reused for 24 hours; browser stale display capped at seven days. Persisted records can remain until replaced/deleted. Service limits are separate.
sources.redistribution: Preserve source identities and provenance. Substantial publicly used extracted/modified databases can require an ODbL machine-readable database or alteration offer. Sources remain separate; merged display is not a declaration that all input data is ODbL. Review any public composite database before launch.
sources.limits: Bounded queries/coalescing to overpass.osm.ch; no bulk scraping beyond approved dataset queries. No availability guarantee. Public-scale service arrangements remain to be reviewed.
sources.status: Enabled. ODbL obligations apply independently of app software licensing.

sources.licence: Map data is ODbL; hosted tile service has separate usage policy.
sources.attribution: Visible linked © OpenStreetMap attribution on the map.
sources.caching: Normal browser HTTP cache; respect upstream cache headers. No offline download, prefetch or tile archive.
sources.redistribution: Do not treat free tile access as a bulk redistribution or guaranteed hosting entitlement.
sources.limits: Canonical tile.openstreetmap.org URL; valid browser Referer and User-Agent. Service can block heavy/inappropriate use. Choose an appropriate provider before wider usage.
sources.status: Canonical hostname and origin-only cross-site Referer configured; owner-private usage retained.

sources.source: swisstopo swissTLM3D terrain and fountain/spring points; GeoAdmin places
sources.licence: swisstopo free-geodata/geoservices terms (OGD), with dataset-specific source conditions.
sources.caching: Compact February 2026 water edition bundled; refresh explicitly when a new edition is reviewed. Terrain responses reused in bounded route checks; geocoding session caches. API availability is separate from data rights.
sources.redistribution: Attributed use, modification and redistribution permitted under relevant OGD terms. The same grant does not cover every third-party layer visible on geo.admin.ch.
sources.limits: Bounded geometry/response sizes and deadlines. Topographic fountains/springs do not establish drinkability or access; no national completeness claim.
sources.status: Enabled with attribution and unknown water suitability.

sources.source: opentransportdata.swiss GTFS timetable and station-transfer data
sources.licence: Open data platform mobility Switzerland (ODMCH) terms, as linked by dataset catalogue.
sources.attribution: opentransportdata.swiss; publisher/feed dates and processed Re.route index identified.
sources.caching: Compact current/next-year indexes, source archive hash and validity dates. GitHub refresh twice weekly; Worker manifest cache six hours. Feed validity does not replace ongoing refresh.
sources.redistribution: Processing/publication allowed under ODMCH terms with source attribution; Re.route owns responsibility for derived indexes and refreshes. General transfer rules only; service-specific exceptions remain excluded.
sources.limits: 2026 feed valid through 12 December 2026; next-year feed already maintained. No bulk ZIP in app repository. Download/schema/size/hash checks fail closed to a still-valid fallback.

sources.source: Open transport bike/car parking feed (including SBB facilities)
sources.licence: ODMCH terms; publisher cookbook expressly allows publication. This is separate from Trafimage/INSA.
sources.attribution: opentransportdata.swiss and original facility/operator provenance where supplied.
sources.caching: Official parking refreshes after 30 minutes in server/browser caches and periodically while its map layer is visible. Cookbook says every 30 minutes, catalogue daily; the stricter interval is used. Failed refresh can display explicitly labelled older data up to seven days. No occupancy claim.
sources.redistribution: Publication/processing under ODMCH terms, retaining source and update information.
sources.limits: Use provider download, deadlines and schema validation. Capacity is not available spaces; no bicycle occupancy evidence is inferred.
sources.status: Enabled; unrelated to the disabled INSA enrichment.

sources.source: SBB / ODMCH OJP 2 timetable, transfers, realtime and bicycle-condition evidence
sources.licence: ODMCH terms plus registered API access and QoS conditions.
sources.attribution: OJP / opentransportdata.swiss source and check time retained in evidence.
sources.caching: Short bounded memory caches, request coalescing; selected journey realtime refresh while visible. Unknown/stale data is labelled.
sources.redistribution: Processed journey presentation under ODMCH terms. API key is server-only and never redistributed. Permission does not imply bicycle-space availability or booking.
sources.limits: Published free allowance 50 requests/minute and 20,000/day per key; app shared D1 pacing is at most 40/minute with a conservative rolling daily limit. Other applications using the key remain outside this app’s accounting.
sources.status: Enabled with shared quota control; access agreement remains separate from source rights.

sources.licence: ODMCH/API conditions; integration access does not establish production ticket/fare access.
sources.attribution: Provider/test-system source retained in test tooling; reviewed published tariffs use their own citations.
sources.caching: Production endpoint disabled; no new test-fare requests from cards or price comparison.
sources.redistribution: Integration quotations are not a confirmed production offer or sale. Production arrangements and wording must be resolved before re-enabling.
sources.limits: No test quotes shown in the app. Unknown passenger fares stay unknown; reviewed published bicycle/day-pass and limited local tariffs remain.
sources.status: Disabled in shipped client and server; parser/integration tests retained.

sources.source: SBB Trafimage / INSA station facilities and plan-derived floor details
sources.licence: Exact endpoint-specific republication permission unverified. General Trafimage terms include agreed-purpose, publication-consent and onward-transfer restrictions.
sources.attribution: © SBB CFF FFS would remain necessary if a suitable permission is obtained.
sources.caching: Client acquisition disabled; stored provider records purged on next app load. Server blocks before cache/upstream access. Old code/historical records are not evidence of permission.
sources.redistribution: Disabled pending written clarification for precise API, fields, audience, caching, derived display and exports. Ordinary external links to official plans do not republish the plans.
sources.limits: No live facility enrichments or reviewed plan-derived floor/grid entries displayed. Do not extend this restriction to every SBB-origin dataset.
sources.status: Disabled by default, including old-client endpoint calls. Provider not contacted.

sources.source: Graubünden Tourism / Flims Laax Falera / Outdooractive POI pages
sources.licence: No clear permission for automated extraction, caching and republication was verified. A public page is not an open-data grant.
sources.attribution: Original publisher and content-owner links retained in research documentation.
sources.caching: Page-derived enrichment disabled; existing provider cache records purged on next app load.
sources.redistribution: No automatic page-derived POI display pending permission or an independently licensed replacement. Isolated facts and protected presentation/database rights must not be conflated.
sources.limits: The earlier eight-page pilot is retired from the active UI; OSM and topographic water layers remain.

sources.source: transport.opendata.ch public transport and places API
sources.licence: ODMCH terms for timetables; OSM ODbL for addresses/places/walking data. MIT covers API software, not all returned data.
sources.caching: Provider encourages caching; app uses bounded short memory caches. Privacy notice says Swiss hosting and request URL/IP logs retained 30 days.
sources.redistribution: Apply the relevant underlying source licence to the response content.
sources.limits: Current docs give no fixed per-client quota but throttle repetitive polling. Since 5 October 2026 provider runs its own GTFS/GTFS-RT/MOTIS backend; old search.ch-forwarding descriptions are stale.
sources.status: Enabled; provider-specific access and privacy terms apply.

sources.licence: API terms grant own-purpose nontransferable service use, prohibit sublicensing and permit fees/blocks/changes. No blanket open-data licence verified.
sources.attribution: search.ch timetable source and original evidence URL retained.
sources.caching: App short memory reuse; permissible shared-cache duration and downstream reuse scope require clarification before expansion.
sources.redistribution: Do not describe API responses as openly licensed or assume a commercial-beta grant. Dedicated API/general terms need reconciliation for intended launch.
sources.limits: Published 1,000 route requests/day and 10,080 departure/arrival-table requests/day. Existing bounded per-search pacing is not global multi-user control for this provider.
sources.status: Private-beta fallback only; public/commercial expansion gate.

sources.source: BRouter hosted cycling routing and elevation
sources.licence: MIT routing software; OSM ODbL road data; separate elevation data conditions. Hosted-service rights are not granted by MIT.
sources.attribution: BRouter, © OpenStreetMap contributors and elevation-source acknowledgements.
sources.caching: App uses bounded 30-minute memory reuse. BRouter privacy notice states route-coordinate/IP logs for two weeks plus ten days in backups; processing location not confirmed here.
sources.redistribution: Public-server commercial entitlement, route-output redistribution and exact elevation provenance remain unverified. CGIAR-CSI elevation terms can impose separate commercial/redistribution requirements; do not mark all output unrestricted.
sources.limits: Serial bounded requests, timeout/cancellation, no bulk touring-data scrape. No numerical provider quota/SLA verified. Clarify entitlement or use an appropriately licensed hosted/self-hosted alternative for expansion.
sources.status: Enabled for private testing; commercial/public service and elevation-rights review pending.

sources.source: FOSSGIS routing.openstreetmap.de bicycle backup and walking routes
sources.licence: OSM ODbL data; separate FOSSGIS hosted-service policy.
sources.caching: App bounded memory reuse. Additional caching/redistribution conditions in full policy were not verified because its page was inaccessible.
sources.redistribution: OSM obligations apply to data; no service availability or unlimited commercial hosting entitlement assumed.
sources.limits: Maximum one request/second, valid User-Agent/Referer, no scraping/heavy use. Current queue is shared within one browser; aggregate public-scale control is a remaining gate.
sources.status: Private-beta use only pending scale/policy review.

sources.licence: OSM ODbL underlying place data; Apache 2.0 Photon software. Public demo service has separate fair-use limits.
sources.attribution: Photon and © OpenStreetMap contributors in place search.
sources.caching: Debounced/bounded place lookup and session reuse; no numerical cache TTL or retention established by this audit.
sources.redistribution: Apply OSM terms to geocoded data; no Komoot tour descriptions, photos or scenic-route recommendations are used.
sources.limits: Reasonable request volume only, throttling/bans possible, no uptime guarantee. Review dedicated hosting before larger scale.
sources.status: Enabled for bounded private use; hosted-service conditions remain distinct.

sources.source: SBB / PostBus / RhB / other operators and fare associations — reviewed fares and bicycle rules
sources.licence: Short factual tariff/policy summaries with links. No blanket licence to copy websites, images or tariff publications asserted.
sources.attribution: Per-rule original publisher URL, checked date and validity dates.
sources.caching: Reviewed dated constants/catalogues; changes require source review. Future or unsupported tariff coverage stays unknown.
sources.redistribution: No full tariff documents, photographs or website prose redistributed. App estimates and operator purchase offers are distinguished.
sources.limits: Bicycle permissions, ticket entitlement, reservation requirement and available space are separate. Normal day-pass prices do not establish every operator/reservation charge.
sources.status: Enabled within reviewed scope; future tariff changes need review.
